metric: Calcite optimizer-test pairs from the QED prover, converted from its relational-algebra JSON to SQL, proved equivalent; the other 12 are unknown (none is shown different by a counterexample).
caveats: 390 of QED's 444 cases convert to SQL; 54 use features the conversion cannot reproduce exactly and are not scored (listed with reasons in tests/fixtures/qed/qed_calcite_skipped.jsonl). Added to the conversion on 2026-10-05, each read from QED's plan dump where its IR drops the clause: windows (partition and order), grouping sets, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, multi-column COUNT(DISTINCT), empty projections and ROW. Grouping sets are now converted as GROUP BY GROUPING SETS: before, the 14 grouping-set pairs were scored as plain GROUP BY, a query Calcite's test does not run. Nine of them were counted as proved then (QED's own IR makes the same drop, so QED proves the plain reading); with the sets restored 6 of the 9 are proved and 3 are unknown (testPushCountNullableGroupingSetsThroughUnion, testPushCountStarGroupingSetsThroughUnion, testPushSumCountStarGroupingSetsThroughUnion: a global SUM over a UNION ALL of per-group counts, not proved). The 2 pairs that were shown different by a counterexample (testRightEmptyFullJoin, testStrengthenJoinType) were a harness error, not a false proof by QED: the DuckDB replay stored TIMESTAMP columns as DATE, so CAST(hiredate AS TIMESTAMP) changed the value. With TIMESTAMP stored as TIMESTAMP both are proved and no database separates them; QED's verdict (provable) was right. A replay of a pair that casts text to a number is repeated on digit strings when DuckDB rejects the first one (testJoinProjectTransposeWindow). CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is read as one value shared by both queries of a pair (statement_clock, dynamic_constant_rules.py), as QED does; the DuckDB replay of that pair fixes the clock at two dates the random data can equal, and is a weak check. Windows: testPushProjectWithOverPastJoin1, 2 and 3 are converted and unknown (window proof rules belong to issue #503); testJoinProjectTransposeWindow is proved. Overlaps the SQLSolver and R-Bot Calcite sets (not yet deduplicated). Key-based rules were developed with these pairs in view (tuned on test). The outer-join flattening rules (src/kumosql/outer_join_flatten.py) were written with this suite's failing pairs in view (tuned on test). The structural aggregate rules were developed on the failing-tests triage's aggregate cases from this suite (tuned on test). The correlated LATERAL IN rules (quantified_rules.py, #384) were developed with this suite's correlated IN pairs in view (tuned on test). Batch 1 of the prover rules (#407) proved 7 pairs it was written against (tuned on test): testExpandJoinExists, testIntersectToDistinct, testJoinProjectTranspose1, testPushAggregateThroughOuterJoin6, testPushFilterPastProject, testReduceCastAndConsts and testSemiJoinReduceConstants. The domain-join rules (domain_join_rules.py, #489) proved testSelectAnyCorrelated and testWhereAnyCorrelatedInSelect (tuned on test). S019 proved testTransitiveInferenceJoin3wayAgg (grouped_join_facts.py), testExpandFilterConstantInCorrelatedWithTwoSubQueries (lateral_boolean_groups.py), testDecorrelateAggWithConstantGroupKey (correlated_key_groups.py), testWhereNotInCorrelated and testWhereNotInCorrelated2 (counted_membership.py; the proof carries the condition that grouped-key equality is the GROUP BY equality, including collation and coercion, which callers must check); all tuned on test. This change (the QED gap pairs) proved, with the pairs in view (tuned on test): testAggregateDynamicFunction (dynamic_constant_rules.py), testAggregateJoinRemove10, testProjectCorrelateTransposeRuleAntiCorrelate, testProjectCorrelateTransposeRuleSemiCorrelate, testProjectFilterTransposeRuleOnEmptyRowType, testProjectSetOpTranspose, testReduceConstants, testJoinProjectTransposeWindow and, through a set-operation case of the structural identity check, six grouping-set pairs (structural_identity.py). Still unknown: the 12 listed in the results (testSortJoinTranspose1: tie policy, legal executions differ in exact bags; testPushAggregateSumThroughJoinAfterAggregateReduce; the 3 count grouping-set pairs; the 4 testDistinct* join pairs QED does not prove either; the 3 window pairs).
correctness: 0 false proofs; every proof re-run on 60 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals
coverage_of: All 444 QED Calcite cases: the 390 scored pairs (proven, refuted, unknown) plus the 54 the conversion cannot reproduce exactly (unsupported).
